A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Veggies**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb baby potatoes (halved), 1 broccoli crown (florets), 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves (minced), juice/zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp oregano, salt/pepper.

**Method:** Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper; roast 15 min. Meanwhile, pound chicken to even thickness. Toss chicken and broccoli with remaining oil, garlic, lemon, oregano, salt, pepper. Add to pan, roast 18–20 min until chicken hits 165°F. Rest 5 min, squeeze extra lemon over top.

**Time:** ~35 min total, 10 min active. Serve with crusty bread or quick couscous.
